title: Cauthon Warps
description: a simple yet powerful warps plugin for server developers.
body:
## Cauthon Warps
Cauthon Warps is a warps plugin (shocker) that lets server staff to set warps normal players can teleport to.

Commands:
1. /cwarpop create/delete/enable/disable [WarpName]
2. /cwarp [WarpName]

## Configuration
1. teleportDelay: 5 (Default): Teleport Time for Warps

We have a discord now!!! [https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD](https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD)
